title: Terms and Conditions
note: This is a structured summary written for app display, not a word-for-word copy of the source website. Verify the current official terms before relying on them.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: The Holidays Service Club provides access to domestic and international holiday packages, hotels, resorts, and tours.
Using the website, registering, purchasing a package, or using its services means the customer agrees to the applicable terms.
Customers must be at least 18 years old, follow applicable laws, and provide accurate booking and account information.
Annual Maintenance Charges (AMC) may be required each year; non-payment may lead to suspension of services.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of Terms
content: Customers who use the website or services agree to the terms and later updates.
Customers must have legal capacity to enter an agreement and keep their account details accurate.
Holiday packages and destinations depend on availability and may be changed or withdrawn.
Customers must pay package prices and applicable fees, follow hotel and resort rules, and review updated terms.
Specific dates, destinations, or outcomes are not guaranteed.

sections.title: 3. Booking Process
content: Booking requests should be sent to booking@theholidaysclubs.com or submitted through another method specified by the company.
Bookings are subject to availability and are handled in order of request.
The website states that confirmed bookings cannot be cancelled or modified.
Package durations may include options such as 6 nights/7 days or 3 nights/4 days, subject to availability.

sections.title: 4. Payment Terms
content: Accepted payment methods may include cards, net banking, and other approved electronic payment methods.
Payments may be processed by third-party payment gateways, whose terms also apply.
The page describes vacation charges and related fees as non-refundable.
Payment confirmations are sent using the contact details supplied by the customer.
Customers are responsible for applicable taxes and additional charges. Unpaid balances may result in booking cancellation or suspended access.

sections.title: 5. Annual Maintenance Charges (AMC)
content: Annual maintenance charges may apply from the package purchase date and may be revised.
The page says AMC should be paid within 90 days of the effective date or before the first vacation, whichever comes first.
AMC is payable annually even if the customer does not use the vacation benefits.
Unpaid AMC may suspend benefits until outstanding amounts are cleared.

sections.title: 6. Validity and Cash-Out Price
content: A package becomes valid after the required full payment is made.
For a cash-out offer, the page specifies completing payment within 30 days of the initial payment.
Failure to complete payment within the specified period may lead to cancellation, forfeiture of partial payments, or reversion to the full product price.

sections.title: 7. Product Downgrade
content: Failure to pay instalments or AMC by the deadline may result in a lower-value package with reduced benefits.

sections.title: 8. Identification and KYC Compliance
content: Customers may need to provide valid identity proof, two passport-size photographs, and required KYC information before a vacation card is issued.
Applications that do not meet KYC requirements may be rejected.

sections.title: 9. Withdrawal of Properties
content: The company may change or remove listed hotels, resorts, or other properties without prior notice.
Bookings remain subject to availability and priority rules, including during high-occupancy periods.

sections.title: 10. Splitting of Stays
content: During peak periods, a continuous stay may be divided into shorter stays. The page says unused portions are not refunded or credited.

sections.title: 11. Exchange Fee
content: An exchange fee may apply when a customer chooses an associated domestic or international property outside the standard offerings.

sections.title: 12. Indemnification
content: Customers may be responsible for claims, losses, expenses, or liabilities arising from their use of the services, breach of terms, negligence or misconduct, legal non-compliance, third-party claims, or reservation changes.

sections.title: 13. Representations and Warranties
content: Customers confirm that they meet the eligibility requirements and have authority to enter the agreement.
Information supplied for accounts, payments, and bookings must be accurate and current.
Customers must comply with applicable laws, avoid misrepresenting identity, have authority to book for minors, and be authorized to use the selected payment method.
Customers acknowledge that travel involves risks.

sections.title: 14. Limitation of Liability
content: The page limits the company's responsibility for certain indirect or consequential losses, data loss, travel-related injury or property damage, third-party service issues, booking disruptions, and events outside its control.
It states that the company's total liability is capped at the amount paid for the service or product related to the claim, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 15. Intellectual Property
content: Website content, trademarks, logos, designs, graphics, software, and related intellectual property belong to the company or its licensors.
Customers receive limited personal, non-commercial access and may not reproduce, modify, distribute, or create derivative works without permission.
The page also describes the company's rights regarding feedback and protection against infringement.

sections.title: 16. Force Majeure
content: The company says it is not responsible for delays or failures caused by circumstances outside its reasonable control, such as conflict, civil unrest, natural disasters, or government action.

sections.title: 17. Amendments
content: The company may update the terms. Continued use of the website or services after an update is treated as acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: 18. Refund
content: The page states that payments for packages, deposits, instalments, AMC, and full package amounts are non-refundable, including in cases of cancellation or changes.

sections.title: 19. Dispute Resolution and Jurisdiction
content: The parties should first try to resolve disputes amicably.
If that fails, the page specifies arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
It identifies courts in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India as having exclusive jurisdiction over related matters.

sections.title: Contact Information
content: Booking email: booking@theholidaysclubs.com
General information email: info@theholidaysclubs.com
The terms page lists an office address in Manali, Haripur, Naggar Road, near State Bank of India ATM, PIN 175136.

sections.title: Refund Policy
content: The separate refund policy states that completed purchases are final and that package payments, processing fees, and related charges are not refunded.
Packages are described as non-transferable. Date changes or upgrades may be considered at the company's discretion and may incur extra charges.
In exceptional circumstances, customers may contact the grievance team to ask about alternatives such as rescheduling; this does not promise a refund.
Grievance contact: info@theholidaysclubs.com, 1800 274 3000. Listed office hours are Monday to Friday, 10:30 AM–5:30 PM IST.

sections.title: Withdrawal Policy
content: The company may remove a property from its offerings because of operational, legal, partnership, maintenance, or business reasons.
Depending on availability, alternatives may include a comparable property or a future booking date.
The policy states that property withdrawal does not result in a refund, including certain temporary unavailability situations.

sections.title: Grievance Redressal
content: First level: email info@theholidaysclubs.com from the registered email address; the page states a response target of 3 working days.
Second level: if unresolved, email booking@theholidaysclubs.com from the registered email address after contacting the first level; the page states a response target of 2 working days.
Third level: if still unresolved, email legal@theholidaysclubs.com after completing the earlier steps; the page states a response target of up to 5 working days.

sections.title: Data Storage, Retention, and Deletion
content: The page says personal information is stored on protected servers or cloud systems, with security measures such as encryption and access controls.
Full payment-card details are described as being handled by third-party payment gateways rather than retained in full by the company.

Personal data is retained as needed for bookings, membership, service delivery, and legal compliance; the page generally describes a five-year retention period from the last interaction or transaction unless a longer period is required.
When data is no longer needed, it may be deleted or anonymized. Users may request deletion subject to contractual and legal requirements.
The page describes backup safeguards and investigation/notification steps for security incidents where legally required.

sections.title: Purpose of Data Collection and Processing
content: Personal information may be processed to manage bookings, check-in and check-out, guest registration, memberships, loyalty benefits, payments, accounting, fraud prevention, and customer support.

The page also describes personalization, analytics, service improvement, marketing and loyalty communications where consent has been provided, and compliance with legal, regulatory, and security obligations.
